name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.240.0 — The old-test cleanup's --apply now fills a gateCommand's {testDirs}/{scopeDirs} with the test files it left in the folders it touched, instead of passing the placeholder to the shell; before, any project with a scoped gate saw every cleanup undone. This repo's 272 expired tests are retired. 7.239.0 — The run skill that /spec:init generates now launches the app on a free PORT and reads its URLs from it, matching the port rule already in init's profile step; port-check no longer flags this repo's own port-check test. 7.238.0 — Worktree creation now runs the host's setupCommand itself, on a fresh create and on a re-attach, and undoes the create when setup fails — host setup is no longer a prose step a session can shorten. Create also refuses a spec that is not committed on the base (--spec), and /spec:plan's lock commits the spec, its ledger row and any brief it wrote, so /spec:run always branches from a tree that carries the spec.
